stories.title: Tashkent administration to engage McKinsey
stories.summary: The Tashkent administration plans to engage McKinsey & Company to improve urban governance and develop a shared vision for the city through 2030. The city hokimiyat says the partnership aims to translate strategic decisions into concrete projects. The administration has not detailed the cost of the engagement.

stories.title: SEC approves looser audit quality rules
stories.summary: The SEC has approved revisions to the PCAOB quality-control standard QC 1000, clearing the way for less demanding requirements supported by Deloitte, PwC, EY and KPMG. The firms argued the original rules imposed unnecessary costs and complexity. The new standard governs how firms evaluate their internal systems.

stories.title: Accenture to correct AI-generated report
stories.summary: Accenture will correct a report on African agriculture after GPTZero identified numerous errors and fake citations. The consultancy attributed the mistakes to human error rather than AI malfunctions. Accenture declined to explain how it determined the source of the errors or why it ruled out AI involvement.

stories.title: Vodafone Idea launches AI lab with PwC
stories.summary: Vodafone Idea has launched Vi Intelligence and partnered with PwC India to open the Vi Intelligence Lab in Mumbai. The facility aims to develop agentic and assistive AI solutions for enterprise customers. The telecom operator joins other Indian firms building in-house capacity for autonomous technology systems.

stories.title: Vodafone Idea Launches Vi Intelligence, Partners With PwC India to Drive Enterprise AI
stories.summary: Vodafone Idea Launches Vi Intelligence, Partners With PwC India to Drive Enterprise AI Vodafone Idea launches Vi Intelligence, an AI-led initiative in partnership with PwC India to accelerate enterprise AI adoption and transform its internal operations. The collaboration will establish the Vi Intelligence Lab to

stories.title: Dublin couple face charges in homicide
stories.summary: New court records reveal that a couple charged with the homicide of a New York Times executive allegedly shot at him over a dozen times. The elder husband reportedly purchased the handguns months in advance. The case marks the only homicide in Dublin this year.

stories.title: FAS expects to recoup McKinsey costs
stories.summary: The Faculty of Arts and Sciences expects to recoup its spending on McKinsey & Company in less than six months following a staff restructuring. FAS Dean Hopi E. Hoekstra announced the timeline at a faculty meeting. The faculty did not disclose the total cost of the consulting contract.

stories.title: Accenture report faces hallucination claims
stories.summary: Accenture is under scrutiny after GPTZero analysis alleged its report on development contained 15 fake citations and fictitious case studies. The consultancy collaborated with IE University on the paper. Accenture has stated it will correct the document, though it maintains the errors were the result of humans.

stories.title: McKinsey AI assistant exposed in data breach
stories.summary: Security startup CodeWall reported that an autonomous agent accessed McKinsey's Lilli AI assistant in two hours without credentials. The breach exposed 46.5 million chat messages and 57,000 user accounts. The system prompts governing Lilli were stored as ordinary rows and were writable through the same injection.

stories.title: CodeWall, McKinsey's Lilli and the Writable Prompt Layer
stories.summary: An AI Agent Hacked McKinsey's Lilli in Two Hours. The Prompts Were Writable. On 28 February 2026, an autonomous offensive-security agent run by the security startup CodeWall found an unauthenticated SQL injection in the public API surface of Lilli, McKinsey & Company's internal AI platform,

stories.title: McKinsey expands Central Asian operations
stories.summary: McKinsey & Company plans to grow its business in Uzbekistan as part of a broader expansion in Central Asia. Global managing partner Bob Sternfels visited Tashkent to meet with government and business leaders. The firm has been active in the region since 2013.

stories.summary: - Industry - 1 min read Vodafone Idea partners PwC India to drive agentic AI-led transformation for enterprises “Telecom has long played a critical role in connecting people, businesses and devices, but the future belongs to intelligence. Through Vi Intelligence Lab, we are bringing together

stories.title: Air pollution costs India 9.5 percent of GDP
stories.summary: A report by FICCI and EY India estimates air pollution costs the country up to 9.5 percent of its GDP annually. The losses stem from premature deaths, healthcare spending and lower worker productivity. The firms estimate annual business losses at approximately $95 billion.

stories.title: McKinsey projects tokenized asset growth
stories.summary: McKinsey forecasts that tokenized real-world assets could reach between $2 trillion and $4 trillion by 2030. The firm suggests this growth will require DeFi applications to adopt standards familiar to traditional finance. The projection was highlighted by a social media commentator.

stories.title: EY reports challenges in AI marketing
stories.summary: An EY study finds that while 88 percent of Indian marketers report business impact from AI, most still rely on standalone tools. The report notes that full-scale integration remains a challenge, with nearly half of brands yet to adopt AI-powered propensity modelling for their marketing strategies.

stories.title: EY notes AI value gap in customer service
stories.summary: EY reports that while organizations are prioritizing AI for customer service, a value realization gap is emerging. The firm notes that as adoption accelerates, companies are struggling to determine why their investments are not consistently creating long-term value for stakeholders, people and society.

stories.title: KPMG India CEO Outlook released
stories.summary: The KPMG 2026 India CEO Outlook indicates that executives remain confident about growth despite geopolitical volatility and regulatory complexity. CEOs are prioritizing investments in cybersecurity and digital capabilities to strengthen resilience. The report highlights a focus on workforce growth and technology as key strategic drivers.

stories.title: EY and FICCI propose shipbuilding pipeline
stories.summary: An EY and FICCI report recommends a 10-year vessel procurement pipeline to boost India's shipbuilding sector. The firms argue this would improve demand visibility and strengthen domestic supply chains. The proposal aims to accelerate industrial scale-up by providing long-term certainty for maritime financing.

stories.title: Indian shoppers lead in AI-completed purchases
stories.summary: Indian shoppers lead 11 markets in letting AI complete their purchases, according to a survey by McKinsey. The firm did not disclose the specific volume of transactions or the types of goods being bought by the automated shoppers.

stories.title: Organizations report rising threat incidents
stories.summary: Nearly nine out of 10 organizations experienced at least one threat-related incident over two years, according to McKinsey. While 75 percent of respondents reported issues with technology and software, the report notes that risk preparedness remains weak. Threats have a habit of ignoring preparation.

stories.title: Business leaders report rising risk exposure
stories.summary: As many as 70 percent of global business leaders report an increase in risk exposure over the past two years, according to KPMG. Technology and AI disruption were identified as the primary concerns for 64 percent of respondents. The world is becoming increasingly difficult to navigate.

stories.title: India battery component costs exceed imports
stories.summary: Domestic battery component production costs in India are 18 percent to 61 percent higher than imported alternatives, according to a Ministry of Heavy Industries study. The government is now considering a targeted support scheme to bridge the gap. Being local currently comes with a premium.

stories.title: McKinsey flags climate risk and cooling gap
stories.summary: Around 60 percent of India's population lives in areas experiencing heat stress, yet air-conditioning coverage is approximately 10 percent, according to McKinsey. In contrast, 90 percent of the US population has access to cooling. Climate exposure is not distributed with equal resources.

stories.title: BCG estimates $2.6 trillion annual AI bill
stories.summary: The AI ecosystem will need $2.6 trillion in annual end-market spending by 2030 to cover data centers, chips, and model development, according to a BCG analysis. This figure represents the amount customers must spend for the buildout to make economic sense. Someone has to pay it.

stories.title: Asper.ai acquires Pricing One assets
stories.summary: Asper.ai has acquired the assets and expertise of Geneva-based Pricing One. The company claims the combination of its agentic AI and the firm's commercial execution plans will help consumer goods companies unlock 6 percent to 8 percent incremental growth. Growth is now a matter of acquisition.

stories.title: Qflow Group acquires J P Chick & Partners
stories.summary: Qflow Group has acquired UK engineering consultancy J P Chick & Partners, adding 35 employees and three offices to its platform. The company reported 2,500 million SEK in revenue, but did not disclose the price paid for the regional firm.

stories.title: Leonard Curtis acquires Parker Andrews
stories.summary: National restructuring consultancy Leonard Curtis has purchased the 30-strong Norwich firm Parker Andrews for an undisclosed fee. The move marks the group's expansion into East Anglia. The firm continues to put funding from private equity house Pollen Street Capital to work.

stories.title: LEO Pharma to acquire dersimelagon rights
stories.summary: LEO Pharma has agreed to acquire the rights to dersimelagon from Tanabe for 435 million dollars. The company describes itself as a global leader in medical dermatology, serving nearly 100 million patients annually across more than 70 countries. The rights were previously held by a Bain-owned entity.

stories.title: Optimus SBR acquires Greenlight Consulting
stories.summary: Management consulting firm Optimus SBR has acquired Greenlight Consulting, a firm specializing in agentic AI and intelligent automation. Greenlight, a UIPath diamond-level partner with 80 employees, primarily serves clients in the banking and public sectors. The firm operates across North America and Costa Rica.

stories.title: JLL acquires data center consultancy VIPA Digital
stories.summary: JLL has acquired data center consultancy VIPA Digital for an undisclosed sum. The firm expects data center infrastructure spending to reach 6.7 trillion dollars through 2030. JLL aims to offer services across the full lifecycle of a data center, which is apparently now a growth industry.

stories.title: JLL expands data center services with acquisition
stories.summary: JLL has acquired data center consultancy VIPA Digital to bolster its service capabilities. The firm stated the acquisition reflects the growing importance of data centers. VIPA founders Vijay Mistry and Paul Cranfield will join JLL’s Work Dynamics division to manage the transition.

stories.title: XPartners Group adds Finnish consultancy
stories.summary: XPartners Group has added Finnish consultancy Niemistö, which reported 2025 revenue of 2.9 million euros. The firm adds approximately 20 employees to the group's roster. No prior-period comparison or transaction terms were provided for the deal.

stories.title: Appliers.ai acquires Prevail
stories.summary: Melbourne-based Appliers.ai has acquired AI strategy specialist Prevail for an undisclosed sum. The entire Prevail team will join the buyer, which claims the two businesses have worked with more than 600 companies. Consolidation is the current strategy for AI firms.

stories.title: Appliers.ai deepens enterprise AI capabilities
stories.summary: Appliers.ai has acquired consultancy Prevail to accelerate demand for AI-led business transformation. Prevail co-founders Pete Gatt and Ben Ashby have joined the leadership team as CTO and chief solutions officer. The financial terms of the deal were not disclosed.

stories.title: Terracon acquires Marx Okubo Associates
stories.summary: Terracon has acquired Marx Okubo Associates, a national architecture and engineering consultancy. The move is intended to provide clients with expanded resources in property due diligence and building assessment. Both firms were previously employee-owned.

stories.title: WilliamsMarston acquisition details unavailable
stories.summary: The full piece regarding WilliamsMarston's acquisition of Analytic Vision is for subscribers. The firm is expanding its OneStream technology practice. Further details were thin in the open report.

stories.title: Cabinet approves INR 14,500 crore for energy storage
stories.summary: The Union Cabinet has approved a Viability Gap Funding scheme worth INR 14,500 crore to support 92 GWh of grid-scale energy storage. The initiative aims to accelerate infrastructure deployment and integrate renewable energy into the national grid between fiscal years 2026 and 2031. Projects are now waiting for the funding.

stories.title: Indian battery components face cost disadvantage
stories.summary: A study by the Netzero Energy Transition Alliance found that Indian battery components cost up to 61 percent more than imported alternatives. The report, prepared for the Ministry of Heavy Industries, suggests three incentive options to help build a domestic supply chain. Being local is currently expensive.

stories.title: Government clears scheme for critical mineral processing
stories.summary: The Union Cabinet approved a Rs 2,814 crore capital support scheme to boost domestic processing of minerals like lithium, nickel and cobalt. The initiative aims to reduce reliance on foreign supply chains for batteries and defence. India is attempting to process its own requirements.

stories.title: Solar manufacturing capacity could reach 3.48 TW by 2047
stories.summary: The Indian Solar Manufacturers Association claims the industry could become a global powerhouse by 2047, attracting $89 billion in investment and eliminating solar import bills. The roadmap suggests moving beyond module assembly to full value chain production. The transition requires a significant increase in current manufacturing scale.

stories.title: Shipbuilding output needs 11-fold increase
stories.summary: India accounted for 0.075 percent of global merchant ship deliveries in 2025, according to a FICCI-EY report. While global deliveries reached 77.28 million gross tonnes, India delivered 57,637 tonnes. The country aims to become a leading shipbuilding nation, though it currently trails Vietnam by a wide margin.

stories.summary: New Delhi [India], November 4 (ANI): India needs a predictable, long-term demand pipeline for domestic vessels and better access to financing to accelerate the growth of its shipbuilding and ship-repair industry, according to a report by EY and the Federation of Indian Chambers of Commerce

stories.title: Food processing sector eyes $600 billion by 2030
stories.summary: A joint report by FICCI and Deloitte states that India's food processing sector is shifting from a volume-driven model to a value-led growth engine. The industry is projected to reach $600 billion by 2030 through technology adoption and exports. The sector is currently undergoing a structural transformation.

stories.title: BDO India appoints Shakir Iqbal as HR partner
stories.summary: BDO India has appointed Shakir Iqbal as Associate Partner for Human Resources. Iqbal joins the firm after serving as Senior Director of Group HR at Burjeel Holdings and spending 15 years at PwC India. He will lead the firm's HR business partnering function.

stories.title: Deloitte Consulting adds nine partners in Africa
stories.summary: Deloitte Consulting has appointed nine new partners to its African operations. Managing Partner Arun Babu stated the move strengthens the firm's expertise in strategy and digital transformation. The consulting arm currently employs over 2,000 practitioners across the continent.

stories.title: North Highland acquires Bluestock Advisors team
stories.summary: Management consulting firm North Highland has added the 16-person team from Bluestock Advisors. Founder Jennifer Merritt will rejoin North Highland as a senior managing director and Atlanta market lead. The firm provides advisory services to the retail, technology and insurance sectors.

stories.summary: KPMG has hired Josh McIntyre as a tax senior manager in Anchorage. The firm describes itself as the only Big Four accounting presence in Alaska. research.title: Stochastic Optimal Control with Measurable Coefficients and Applications
research.summary: Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: We consider fully non-linear stochastic optimal control problems with measurable coefficients and (local) uniformly elliptic diffusion. Using the theory of $L^p$-viscosity solutions, we show existence of an $L^p$-viscosity solution $v\in W_{\rm loc}^{2,p}$ of the Hamilton-Jacobi-Bellman (HJB). Preprint, not peer reviewed.

Yet, how tariffs and DSTs. Preprint, not peer reviewed.

Platforms could also ask people directly, but asking is costly: 98.8% of the prompts in our data went unanswered. Theories of statistical prediction imply. Preprint, not peer reviewed.
